limits: ORCA constrains planar disc velocities from selected neighbors at the observed current velocity. It is not Detour/Mass, NavMesh carving, acceleration-constrained control, nonplanar surface projection or a universal collision guarantee. Walls and dynamic physical response remain owned by the existing pathfinder/motor.

The legacy/simple mode remains the default. ORCA is opt-in, may produce best-effort infeasible output during overlaps/congestion, and can leave NavMesh boundaries. Mixed dynamic-parent motor hierarchies and physical acceleration constraints need further integration.

1000-agent Node solver samples are not total game FPS or a PC120/mobile60 guarantee. Dense16-neighbor warmed samples were around14–15ms and sparse around6–8ms on this machine; no phone or platform performance claim.
The full16-page paper and linked documentation/API/media were not all read; global corpus gate unchanged.
